This is a Safari Web Extension. The app only explains how to turn it on; the dictionary works on web pages in Safari.

1. Open the Dhamma.gift Dictionary app and click "Open Safari Settings…". Safari opens Settings > Extensions. The app window stays open with these steps.
2. In the list on the left, tick "Dhamma.gift Search and Word Lookup". (Safari does not pre-select an extension that is still off, so it may first show "Add Extensions"; the extension is in the left column.)
3. Click "Edit Websites…" and set "When visiting other websites" to Allow, or choose "Always Allow on Every Website" when Safari asks.
4. Open https://dhamma.gift/mn1 in Safari and click any Pali word: a dictionary popup appears.

Note: if Safari refuses to tick the box with "Safari detected an app or service that interfered with clicking", an app with Accessibility permission (remote access, automation or menu-bar utilities) is running. Quit it and tick the box again.
